name: end-to-end-studio
description: Skills for architecture and urban design competitions, from the brief to the panels, in nine topics. Install one topic into any project, or all of them to run the studio.

plugins.name: brief
plugins.description: Reads the brief: a checklist of what it asks for, its numbers, drawings, scales and format.

plugins.name: utilities
plugins.description: Tools any project can use: PDFs to Markdown with their tables, pictures and vector plans.

plugins.name: site
plugins.description: Collects the data of a site: its boundary, buildings, plots, streets, water, rail, climate.

plugins.name: analysis
plugins.description: Measures a site as it is and a design on it, with the same measures, so the two can be compared.

plugins.name: concept
plugins.description: The idea of an entry: its storyline and text, the urban structure, the programme.

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: The design itself: buildings, streets and open spaces, mobility, phases.

plugins.name: drawings
plugins.description: Plans, sections, axonometrics, diagrams and views, drawn to one standard made from reference images, at the scales a brief asks for.

plugins.name: delivery
plugins.description: The finished entry: panels laid out along the storyline, and a jury's reading of them.

plugins.name: studio
plugins.description: The lead that runs the other skills as a studio on a competition brief, and keeps versions of the proposal.
